author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Imagine being obsessed with a particular piece of museum armor, only to work on it for your JOB as an adult. Such is the case of @metmuseum's associate conservator Sean Belair, who introduces Adam Savage to incredibly intricate human and horse armor from the 1500s, and explains how he and his team approached necessary changes to past conservation decisions.

More about this artifact: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/22874
